completion_reason: Three material workflow and information-hierarchy decisions remain unresolved across Work, Workflows, and Runs.

questions.label: Work layout
questions.context: Work must support conversations while keeping per-conversation memory understandable.
questions.question: How should the Work tab organize conversations?

choices.text: Conversation list, active transcript, and collapsible context panel
Full-screen transcript with conversations and context in drawers
Dashboard cards that open separate conversation views

questions.label: Workflow builder
questions.context: Workflows must expose schedules, batches, stages, and stage authority without crowding the first screen.
questions.question: How should operators build and edit workflows?

choices.text: Linear stage lane with foldout configuration per stage
Form-based wizard with one stage per step
Freeform node canvas with connected stages
Editable table with one row per stage

questions.label: Runs hierarchy
questions.context: Runs must make immutable evidence, artifacts, validation, and approvals easy to inspect.
questions.question: What should be the primary Runs detail view?

choices.text: Stage timeline with evidence and artifacts nested under each stage
Tabbed detail for evidence, artifacts, validation, and approvals
Artifact-first file browser with run metadata
